```plaintext
  vehicles                 Vehicle[]
  calculations             Calculation[]
  policies                 Policy[]

  @@map("organizations")
}

model FeatureFlag {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId String?
  featureKey     String // np. "multi_tenant", "advanced_reports", "external_integrations"
  enabled        Boolean  @default(false)
  config         Json? // Dodatkowa konfiguracja
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([organizationId, featureKey])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([featureKey])
  @@map("feature_flags")
}

model IntegrationTab {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  title     String
  content   Json // Dynamiczna zawartość zakładki
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([order])
  @@map("integration_tabs")
}

model CustomField {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId String?
  name           String
  type           String // TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, SELECT
  required       Boolean  @default(false)
  options        Json? // Opcje dla typu SELECT
  order          Int      @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("custom_fields")
}

```

```plaintext
// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum UserRole {
  ADMIN
  USER
}

enum ClientStatus {
  NEW_LEAD
  IN_CONTACT
  DEMO_SENT
  NEGOTIATION
  ACTIVE_CLIENT
  LOST
}

enum TaskStatus {
  TODO
  IN_PROGRESS
  COMPLETED
}

enum ContactType {
  PHONE_CALL
  MEETING
  EMAIL
  LINKEDIN_MESSAGE
  OTHER
}

enum ClientPriority {
  LOW
  MEDIUM
  HIGH
}

enum ClientType {
  PERSON
  COMPANY
}

enum PlanType {
  BASIC
  PRO
}

enum InsuranceVariant {
  MINIMAL
  OPTIMAL
  MAXIMAL
}

enum InsuranceScope {
  OC
  AC
  NNW
  ASS
}

enum CalculationStatus {
  DRAFT
  SENT
  ACCEPTED
  REJECTED
}

enum PolicyStatus {
  ACTIVE
  EXPIRED
  CANCELLED
  RENEWED
}

enum SyncDirection {
  IN
  OUT
}

enum SyncStatus {
  PENDING
  SUCCESS
  FAILED
}

enum ValidationLevel {
  STRICT
  RELAXED
}

enum ConsentType {
  MARKETING
  DATA_PROCESSING
  COMMUNICATION
}

enum DataType {
  PERSONAL_DATA
  VEHICLE_DATA
  POLICY_DATA
}

model User {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  email          String    @unique
  emailVerified  DateTime?
  name           String?
  image          String?
  password       String? // Nullable for OAuth users
  role           UserRole  @default(USER)
  position       String?
  organizationId String?
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization      Organization?      @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id])
  assignedClients   Client[]           @relation("ClientAssignee")
  assignedTasks      Task[]             @relation("TaskAssignee")
  contacts           Contact[]
  groups             UserGroup[]
  activities         ActivityLog[]
  preferences        UserPreferences?
  insuranceAgent     InsuranceAgent?
  assignedCalculations Calculation[]    @relation("CalculationAssignee")
  assignedPolicies   Policy[]           @relation("PolicyAssignee")

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("users")
}

model Group {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String   @unique
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  users          UserGroup[]
  sharedClients  Client[]    @relation("GroupSharedClients")
  sharedTasks    Task[]      @relation("GroupSharedTasks")
  sharedContacts Contact[]   @relation("GroupSharedContacts")

  @@map("groups")
}

model UserGroup {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  groupId   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user  User  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  group Group @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, groupId])
  @@map("user_groups")
}

model Client {
  id             String          @id @default(cuid())
  type           ClientType      @default(PERSON)
  // Fields for PERSON type
  firstName      String?
  lastName       String?
  pesel          String? // PESEL dla osoby fizycznej
  // Fields for COMPANY type
  companyName    String?
  taxId          String? // NIP / Tax ID
  regon          String? // REGON dla firmy
  // Common fields
  email          String?
  phone          String?
  website        String?
  address        String?
  source         String? // Lead source
  status         ClientStatus    @default(NEW_LEAD)
  priority       ClientPriority? // Priority for prospecting
  assignedTo     String? // User ID
  organizationId String?
  lastContactAt  DateTime? // Last contact date (auto-updated)
  nextFollowUpAt DateTime? // Next follow-up date
  // Additional fields for insurance agents
  previousLastName String? // Poprzednie nazwisko
  drivingLicenseDate DateTime? // Data uzyskania prawa jazdy
  occupation      String? // Zawód
  maritalStatus   String? // Stan cywilny
  hasChildUnder26 Boolean? @default(false) // Dziecko poniżej 26 roku życia
  // Correspondence address (if different)
  correspondenceAddress Json? // Adres korespondencyjny jako JSON
  createdAt      DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime        @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization    Organization?         @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id])
  assignee        User?                 @relation("ClientAssignee", fields: [assignedTo], references: [id])
  contacts        Contact[]
  tasks           Task[]
  statusHistory   ClientStatusHistory[]
  sharedGroups    Group[]               @relation("GroupSharedClients")
  integrationTabs IntegrationTab[]
  vehicleOwners   VehicleOwner[]
  calculations    Calculation[]
  policies        Policy[]
  dataConsents    DataConsent[]

  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([lastContactAt])
  @@index([nextFollowUpAt])
  @@index([assignedTo, status])
  @@map("clients")
}

model ClientStatusHistory {
  id        String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  status    ClientStatus
  changedAt DateTime     @default(now())
  changedBy String? // User ID
  notes     String?

  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("client_status_history")
}

model Contact {
  id        String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  type      ContactType? // Optional for notes (isNote=true)
  date      DateTime     @default(now())
  notes     String
  isNote    Boolean      @default(false) // Flag to distinguish notes from contacts
  userId    String // User who created the contact
  createdAt DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client       Client       @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user         User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  attachments  Attachment[]
  sharedGroups Group[]      @relation("GroupSharedContacts")

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([date])
  @@map("contacts")
}

model Attachment {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  contactId String
  filename  String
  path      String // File path or URL
  size      Int? // File size in bytes
  mimeType  String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  contact Contact @relation(fields: [contactId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("attachments")
}

model Task {
  id          String     @id @default(cuid())
  title       String
  description String?
  dueDate     DateTime?
  status      TaskStatus @default(TODO)
  assignedTo  String? // User ID
  clientId    String? // Optional client relation
  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime   @updatedAt

  // Relations
  assignee     User?   @relation("TaskAssignee", fields: [assignedTo], references: [id])
  client       Client? @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id])
  sharedGroups Group[] @relation("GroupSharedTasks")

  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([dueDate])
  @@index([assignedTo, status])
  @@map("tasks")
}

model ActivityLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  action     String // e.g., "CREATE_CLIENT", "UPDATE_CLIENT", "DELETE_CONTACT"
  entityType String // e.g., "Client", "Contact", "Task"
  entityId   String?
  details    Json? // Additional details as JSON
  ipAddress  String?
  userAgent  String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@map("activity_logs")
}

model UserPreferences {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String @unique
  user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // Theme and appearance
  theme    String? @default("light") // "light" | "dark"
  language String? @default("pl") // "pl" | "en"
  timezone String? // IANA timezone (e.g., "Europe/Warsaw", "America/New_York")

  // Color scheme
  primaryColor String? // Hex color (e.g., #3b82f6)
  themeName    String? // "blue" | "green" | "purple" | "red" | "custom" | "system"

  // Notifications
  emailTasks    Boolean @default(true)
  emailContacts Boolean @default(true)

  // Changelog tracking
  lastSeenVersion String? // Last version seen in "What's New"

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("user_preferences")
}

model SystemSettings {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  key       String   @unique
  value     String // JSON string or plain string
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("system_settings")
}

model Organization {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  plan      PlanType @default(BASIC)
  settings  Json? // Konfiguracja funkcji per-organizacja
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  users                    User[]
  clients                  Client[]
  featureFlags             FeatureFlag[]
  customFields             CustomField[]
  insuranceSettings        OrganizationInsuranceSettings?
  insuranceAgents          InsuranceAgent[]
  vehicles                 Vehicle[]
  calculations             Calculation[]
  policies                 Policy[]

  @@map("organizations")
}

model FeatureFlag {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId String?
  featureKey     String // np. "multi_tenant", "advanced_reports", "external_integrations"
  enabled        Boolean  @default(false)
  config         Json? // Dodatkowa konfiguracja
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([organizationId, featureKey])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([featureKey])
  @@map("feature_flags")
}

model IntegrationTab {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  title     String
  content   Json // Dynamiczna zawartość zakładki
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([order])
  @@map("integration_tabs")
}

model CustomField {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId String?
  name           String
  type           String // TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, SELECT
  required       Boolean  @default(false)
  options        Json? // Opcje dla typu SELECT
  order          Int      @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("custom_fields")
}

// Insurance Agent Model
model InsuranceAgent {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String   @unique
  licenseNumber String?  // Numer licencji agenta
  settings      Json?    // Konfiguracja widoczności elementów (JSON)
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  organizationId String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  user         User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([isActive])
  @@map("insurance_agents")
}

// Vehicle Model
model Vehicle {
  id                    String   @id @default(cuid())
  vin                   String?  @unique // Vehicle Identification Number
  registrationNumber    String?  // Numer rejestracyjny
  firstRegistrationDate DateTime? // Data pierwszej rejestracji
  // Dane z Eurotax/Info-Ekspert (JSON)
  eurotaxData          Json?     // Dane z Eurotax
  infoEkspertData      Json?     // Dane z Info-Ekspert
  // Dodatkowe informacje
  importedFromAbroad   Boolean   @default(false) // Sprowadzony z zagranicy
  hasValidInspection  Boolean?  // Czy jest ważne badanie techniczne
  hasLpgInstallation  Boolean?  @default(false) // Czy posiada instalację gazową
  purchaseYear         Int?      // Rok nabycia pojazdu
  currentMileage       Int?      // Aktualny przebieg
  organizationId       String?
  createdAt            DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization  Organization?    @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  owners        VehicleOwner[]    // Relacja N:M z Client
  calculations  Calculation[]
  policies      Policy[]

  @@index([vin])
  @@index([registrationNumber])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("vehicles")
}

// VehicleOwner - relacja N:M między Vehicle a Client
model VehicleOwner {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  vehicleId String
  clientId  String
  isPrimary Boolean  @default(true) // Główny właściciel
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  vehicle Vehicle @relation(fields: [vehicleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  client  Client  @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([vehicleId, clientId])
  @@index([vehicleId])
  @@index([clientId])
  @@map("vehicle_owners")
}

// Calculation Model (Kalkulacja/Szansa sprzedaży)
model Calculation {
  id                    String            @id @default(cuid())
  // Dane osobowe klienta
  pesel                 String?
  firstName             String?
  lastName              String?
  previousLastName      String?           // Poprzednie nazwisko
  phone                 String?
  email                 String?
  // Adres zamieszkania
  postalCode            String?           // Kod pocztowy
  city                  String?           // Miejscowość/Poczta
  street                String?           // Ulica
  houseNumber           String?           // Numer domu
  apartmentNumber       String?           // Numer mieszkania
  // Adres korespondencyjny (jeśli inny)
  correspondenceAddress Json?             // Adres korespondencyjny jako JSON
  // Dane dodatkowe
  hasDrivingLicense     Boolean?           // Prawo jazdy odpowiednie dla pojazdu
  drivingLicenseDate    DateTime?         // Data uzyskania prawa jazdy
  occupation            String?            // Zawód
  maritalStatus         String?            // Stan cywilny
  hasChildUnder26       Boolean?           @default(false) // Dziecko poniżej 26 roku życia
  // Powiązania
  clientId              String?
  vehicleId             String?
  agentId               String?            // Przypisany agent
  organizationId        String?
  // Pola biznesowe
  status                CalculationStatus  @default(DRAFT)
  value                 Decimal?           @db.Decimal(10, 2) // Wartość kalkulacji
  validUntil            DateTime?          // Data ważności
  // Dane z formularza ubezpieczenia
  variant               InsuranceVariant?    // Wariant ubezpieczenia
  scopes                InsuranceScope[]   // Zakres ubezpieczenia (array)
  // Dane z systemu zewnętrznego
  externalId            String?
  syncedAt              DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime           @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client        Client?            @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  vehicle       Vehicle?            @relation(fields: [vehicleId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  agent         User?               @relation("CalculationAssignee", fields: [agentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  organization  Organization?       @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  history       CalculationHistory[]
  externalSyncs ExternalSync[]

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([vehicleId])
  @@index([agentId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([clientId, status])
  @@map("calculations")
}

// InsuranceCompany Model (Towarzystwo Ubezpieczeniowe)
model InsuranceCompany {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String   @unique
  code        String?  @unique // Kod TU
  logoUrl     String?  // URL do logo
  website     String?  // Strona www
  integrationConfig Json? // Konfiguracja integracji (JSON)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  policies Policy[]

  @@index([code])
  @@map("insurance_companies")
}

// Policy Model (Polisa)
model Policy {
  id                String       @id @default(cuid())
  policyNumber      String       @unique // Numer polisy
  issueDate         DateTime     // Data wystawienia
  validFrom         DateTime     // Data ważności od
  validTo           DateTime     // Data ważności do
  status            PolicyStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  // Powiązania
  calculationId     String?      // Powiązana kalkulacja
  clientId          String?
  vehicleId         String?
  insuranceCompanyId String
  agentId           String?      // Agent który wystawił polisę
  organizationId    String?
  // Dane z systemu zewnętrznego
  externalId        String?
  syncedAt         DateTime?
  createdAt         DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations
  calculation       Calculation? @relation(fields: [calculationId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  client            Client?      @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  vehicle           Vehicle?     @relation(fields: [vehicleId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  insuranceCompany  InsuranceCompany @relation(fields: [insuranceCompanyId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  agent             User?        @relation("PolicyAssignee", fields: [agentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  organization      Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  documents         PolicyDocument[]
  history           PolicyHistory[]
  externalSyncs     ExternalSync[]

  @@index([policyNumber])
  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([vehicleId])
  @@index([insuranceCompanyId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([validTo])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([status, validTo])
  @@map("policies")
}

// PolicyDocument Model
model PolicyDocument {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  policyId  String
  filename  String
  path      String   // File path or URL
  size      Int?      // File size in bytes
  mimeType  String?
  uploadedBy String?  // User ID
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  policy Policy @relation(fields: [policyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([policyId])
  @@map("policy_documents")
}

// ExternalSync Model (Synchronizacja z systemem zewnętrznym)
model ExternalSync {
  id            String       @id @default(cuid())
  entityType    String       // "client", "vehicle", "calculation", "policy"
  entityId      String       // ID encji w CRM
  externalId    String?      // ID w systemie zewnętrznym
  direction     SyncDirection // IN lub OUT
  status        SyncStatus   @default(PENDING)
  syncedAt      DateTime?
  error         String?      // Błąd synchronizacji
  requestPayload Json?       // Payload requestu
  responsePayload Json?      // Payload odpowiedzi
  retryCount    Int          @default(0)
  nextRetryAt   DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations - opcjonalne powiązania
  calculation   Calculation? @relation(fields: [entityId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  policy        Policy?      @relation(fields: [entityId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([entityType])
  @@index([entityId])
  @@index([externalId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([syncedAt])
  @@unique([entityType, entityId, direction])
  @@map("external_syncs")
}

// OrganizationInsuranceSettings Model
model OrganizationInsuranceSettings {
  id                  String          @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId      String          @unique
  validationLevel     ValidationLevel @default(RELAXED)
  encryptionEnabled   Boolean         @default(false)
  auditRetentionDays  Int?            // Okres retencji logów audytu (dni)
  gdprEnabled         Boolean         @default(false)
  dataRetentionDays   Int?            // Okres retencji danych (dni)
  cacheEnabled        Boolean         @default(false)
  cacheTTL            Int?            // TTL cache w sekundach
  createdAt           DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime        @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("organization_insurance_settings")
}

// CalculationHistory Model
model CalculationHistory {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  calculationId String
  field         String   // Nazwa pola które się zmieniło
  oldValue      String?  // Stara wartość (JSON string)
  newValue      String?  // Nowa wartość (JSON string)
  changedBy     String?  // User ID
  changedAt     DateTime @default(now())
  reason        String?  // Powód zmiany

  // Relations
  calculation Calculation @relation(fields: [calculationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([calculationId])
  @@index([changedAt])
  @@map("calculation_history")
}

// PolicyHistory Model
model PolicyHistory {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  policyId      String
  field         String   // Nazwa pola które się zmieniło
  oldValue      String?  // Stara wartość (JSON string)
  newValue      String?  // Nowa wartość (JSON string)
  changedBy     String?  // User ID
  changedAt     DateTime @default(now())
  reason        String?  // Powód zmiany

  // Relations
  policy Policy @relation(fields: [policyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([policyId])
  @@index([changedAt])
  @@map("policy_history")
}

// AuditLog Model (rozszerzenie ActivityLog dla danych osobowych)
model AuditLog {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String
  action        String   // Typ akcji
  dataType      DataType // Typ danych (PERSONAL_DATA, VEHICLE_DATA, POLICY_DATA)
  entityType    String   // Typ encji
  entityId      String?  // ID encji
  dataBefore    Json?    // Dane przed zmianą
  dataAfter     Json?    // Dane po zmianie
  ipAddress     String?
  userAgent     String?
  retentionPeriod Int?   // Okres retencji (dni)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([dataType])
  @@index([entityType])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}

// DataConsent Model (Zgody RODO)
model DataConsent {
  id          String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId    String
  consentType ConsentType
  granted     Boolean      @default(false)
  grantedAt   DateTime?
  expiresAt   DateTime?    // Data wygaśnięcia zgody
  revokedAt   DateTime?    // Data cofnięcia zgody
  notes       String?      // Notatki
  createdAt   DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([consentType])
  @@index([granted])
  @@unique([clientId, consentType])
  @@map("data_consents")
}

```


Sprawdzanie błędów w schemacie Prisma:



Korygowanie relacji w ExternalSync: usuwanie relacji do Calculation i Policy, pozostawienie tylko entityType + entityId jako identyfikatorów.


```plaintext
// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum UserRole {
  ADMIN
  USER
}

enum ClientStatus {
  NEW_LEAD
  IN_CONTACT
  DEMO_SENT
  NEGOTIATION
  ACTIVE_CLIENT
  LOST
}

enum TaskStatus {
  TODO
  IN_PROGRESS
  COMPLETED
}

enum ContactType {
  PHONE_CALL
  MEETING
  EMAIL
  LINKEDIN_MESSAGE
  OTHER
}

enum ClientPriority {
  LOW
  MEDIUM
  HIGH
}

enum ClientType {
  PERSON
  COMPANY
}

enum PlanType {
  BASIC
  PRO
}

enum InsuranceVariant {
  MINIMAL
  OPTIMAL
  MAXIMAL
}

enum InsuranceScope {
  OC
  AC
  NNW
  ASS
}

enum CalculationStatus {
  DRAFT
  SENT
  ACCEPTED
  REJECTED
}

enum PolicyStatus {
  ACTIVE
  EXPIRED
  CANCELLED
  RENEWED
}

enum SyncDirection {
  IN
  OUT
}

enum SyncStatus {
  PENDING
  SUCCESS
  FAILED
}

enum ValidationLevel {
  STRICT
  RELAXED
}

enum ConsentType {
  MARKETING
  DATA_PROCESSING
  COMMUNICATION
}

enum DataType {
  PERSONAL_DATA
  VEHICLE_DATA
  POLICY_DATA
}

model User {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  email          String    @unique
  emailVerified  DateTime?
  name           String?
  image          String?
  password       String? // Nullable for OAuth users
  role           UserRole  @default(USER)
  position       String?
  organizationId String?
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization      Organization?      @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id])
  assignedClients   Client[]           @relation("ClientAssignee")
  assignedTasks      Task[]             @relation("TaskAssignee")
  contacts           Contact[]
  groups             UserGroup[]
  activities         ActivityLog[]
  preferences        UserPreferences?
  insuranceAgent     InsuranceAgent?
  assignedCalculations Calculation[]    @relation("CalculationAssignee")
  assignedPolicies   Policy[]           @relation("PolicyAssignee")

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("users")
}

model Group {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String   @unique
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  users          UserGroup[]
  sharedClients  Client[]    @relation("GroupSharedClients")
  sharedTasks    Task[]      @relation("GroupSharedTasks")
  sharedContacts Contact[]   @relation("GroupSharedContacts")

  @@map("groups")
}

model UserGroup {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  groupId   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user  User  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  group Group @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, groupId])
  @@map("user_groups")
}

model Client {
  id             String          @id @default(cuid())
  type           ClientType      @default(PERSON)
  // Fields for PERSON type
  firstName      String?
  lastName       String?
  pesel          String? // PESEL dla osoby fizycznej
  // Fields for COMPANY type
  companyName    String?
  taxId          String? // NIP / Tax ID
  regon          String? // REGON dla firmy
  // Common fields
  email          String?
  phone          String?
  website        String?
  address        String?
  source         String? // Lead source
  status         ClientStatus    @default(NEW_LEAD)
  priority       ClientPriority? // Priority for prospecting
  assignedTo     String? // User ID
  organizationId String?
  lastContactAt  DateTime? // Last contact date (auto-updated)
  nextFollowUpAt DateTime? // Next follow-up date
  // Additional fields for insurance agents
  previousLastName String? // Poprzednie nazwisko
  drivingLicenseDate DateTime? // Data uzyskania prawa jazdy
  occupation      String? // Zawód
  maritalStatus   String? // Stan cywilny
  hasChildUnder26 Boolean? @default(false) // Dziecko poniżej 26 roku życia
  // Correspondence address (if different)
  correspondenceAddress Json? // Adres korespondencyjny jako JSON
  createdAt      DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime        @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization    Organization?         @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id])
  assignee        User?                 @relation("ClientAssignee", fields: [assignedTo], references: [id])
  contacts        Contact[]
  tasks           Task[]
  statusHistory   ClientStatusHistory[]
  sharedGroups    Group[]               @relation("GroupSharedClients")
  integrationTabs IntegrationTab[]
  vehicleOwners   VehicleOwner[]
  calculations    Calculation[]
  policies        Policy[]
  dataConsents    DataConsent[]

  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([lastContactAt])
  @@index([nextFollowUpAt])
  @@index([assignedTo, status])
  @@map("clients")
}

model ClientStatusHistory {
  id        String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  status    ClientStatus
  changedAt DateTime     @default(now())
  changedBy String? // User ID
  notes     String?

  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("client_status_history")
}

model Contact {
  id        String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  type      ContactType? // Optional for notes (isNote=true)
  date      DateTime     @default(now())
  notes     String
  isNote    Boolean      @default(false) // Flag to distinguish notes from contacts
  userId    String // User who created the contact
  createdAt DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client       Client       @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user         User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  attachments  Attachment[]
  sharedGroups Group[]      @relation("GroupSharedContacts")

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([date])
  @@map("contacts")
}

model Attachment {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  contactId String
  filename  String
  path      String // File path or URL
  size      Int? // File size in bytes
  mimeType  String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  contact Contact @relation(fields: [contactId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("attachments")
}

model Task {
  id          String     @id @default(cuid())
  title       String
  description String?
  dueDate     DateTime?
  status      TaskStatus @default(TODO)
  assignedTo  String? // User ID
  clientId    String? // Optional client relation
  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime   @updatedAt

  // Relations
  assignee     User?   @relation("TaskAssignee", fields: [assignedTo], references: [id])
  client       Client? @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id])
  sharedGroups Group[] @relation("GroupSharedTasks")

  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([dueDate])
  @@index([assignedTo, status])
  @@map("tasks")
}

model ActivityLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  action     String // e.g., "CREATE_CLIENT", "UPDATE_CLIENT", "DELETE_CONTACT"
  entityType String // e.g., "Client", "Contact", "Task"
  entityId   String?
  details    Json? // Additional details as JSON
  ipAddress  String?
  userAgent  String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@map("activity_logs")
}

model UserPreferences {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String @unique
  user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // Theme and appearance
  theme    String? @default("light") // "light" | "dark"
  language String? @default("pl") // "pl" | "en"
  timezone String? // IANA timezone (e.g., "Europe/Warsaw", "America/New_York")

  // Color scheme
  primaryColor String? // Hex color (e.g., #3b82f6)
  themeName    String? // "blue" | "green" | "purple" | "red" | "custom" | "system"

  // Notifications
  emailTasks    Boolean @default(true)
  emailContacts Boolean @default(true)

  // Changelog tracking
  lastSeenVersion String? // Last version seen in "What's New"

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("user_preferences")
}

model SystemSettings {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  key       String   @unique
  value     String // JSON string or plain string
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("system_settings")
}

model Organization {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  plan      PlanType @default(BASIC)
  settings  Json? // Konfiguracja funkcji per-organizacja
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  users                    User[]
  clients                  Client[]
  featureFlags             FeatureFlag[]
  customFields             CustomField[]
  insuranceSettings        OrganizationInsuranceSettings?
  insuranceAgents          InsuranceAgent[]
  vehicles                 Vehicle[]
  calculations             Calculation[]
  policies                 Policy[]

  @@map("organizations")
}

model FeatureFlag {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId String?
  featureKey     String // np. "multi_tenant", "advanced_reports", "external_integrations"
  enabled        Boolean  @default(false)
  config         Json? // Dodatkowa konfiguracja
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([organizationId, featureKey])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([featureKey])
  @@map("feature_flags")
}

model IntegrationTab {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  title     String
  content   Json // Dynamiczna zawartość zakładki
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([order])
  @@map("integration_tabs")
}

model CustomField {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId String?
  name           String
  type           String // TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, SELECT
  required       Boolean  @default(false)
  options        Json? // Opcje dla typu SELECT
  order          Int      @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("custom_fields")
}

// Insurance Agent Model
model InsuranceAgent {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String   @unique
  licenseNumber String?  // Numer licencji agenta
  settings      Json?    // Konfiguracja widoczności elementów (JSON)
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  organizationId String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  user         User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([isActive])
  @@map("insurance_agents")
}

// Vehicle Model
model Vehicle {
  id                    String   @id @default(cuid())
  vin                   String?  @unique // Vehicle Identification Number
  registrationNumber    String?  // Numer rejestracyjny
  firstRegistrationDate DateTime? // Data pierwszej rejestracji
  // Dane z Eurotax/Info-Ekspert (JSON)
  eurotaxData          Json?     // Dane z Eurotax
  infoEkspertData      Json?     // Dane z Info-Ekspert
  // Dodatkowe informacje
  importedFromAbroad   Boolean   @default(false) // Sprowadzony z zagranicy
  hasValidInspection  Boolean?  // Czy jest ważne badanie techniczne
  hasLpgInstallation  Boolean?  @default(false) // Czy posiada instalację gazową
  purchaseYear         Int?      // Rok nabycia pojazdu
  currentMileage       Int?      // Aktualny przebieg
  organizationId       String?
  createdAt            DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization  Organization?    @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  owners        VehicleOwner[]    // Relacja N:M z Client
  calculations  Calculation[]
  policies      Policy[]

  @@index([vin])
  @@index([registrationNumber])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("vehicles")
}

// VehicleOwner - relacja N:M między Vehicle a Client
model VehicleOwner {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  vehicleId String
  clientId  String
  isPrimary Boolean  @default(true) // Główny właściciel
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  vehicle Vehicle @relation(fields: [vehicleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  client  Client  @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([vehicleId, clientId])
  @@index([vehicleId])
  @@index([clientId])
  @@map("vehicle_owners")
}

// Calculation Model (Kalkulacja/Szansa sprzedaży)
model Calculation {
  id                    String            @id @default(cuid())
  // Dane osobowe klienta
  pesel                 String?
  firstName             String?
  lastName              String?
  previousLastName      String?           // Poprzednie nazwisko
  phone                 String?
  email                 String?
  // Adres zamieszkania
  postalCode            String?           // Kod pocztowy
  city                  String?           // Miejscowość/Poczta
  street                String?           // Ulica
  houseNumber           String?           // Numer domu
  apartmentNumber       String?           // Numer mieszkania
  // Adres korespondencyjny (jeśli inny)
  correspondenceAddress Json?             // Adres korespondencyjny jako JSON
  // Dane dodatkowe
  hasDrivingLicense     Boolean?           // Prawo jazdy odpowiednie dla pojazdu
  drivingLicenseDate    DateTime?         // Data uzyskania prawa jazdy
  occupation            String?            // Zawód
  maritalStatus         String?            // Stan cywilny
  hasChildUnder26       Boolean?           @default(false) // Dziecko poniżej 26 roku życia
  // Powiązania
  clientId              String?
  vehicleId             String?
  agentId               String?            // Przypisany agent
  organizationId        String?
  // Pola biznesowe
  status                CalculationStatus  @default(DRAFT)
  value                 Decimal?           @db.Decimal(10, 2) // Wartość kalkulacji
  validUntil            DateTime?          // Data ważności
  // Dane z formularza ubezpieczenia
  variant               InsuranceVariant?    // Wariant ubezpieczenia
  scopes                InsuranceScope[]   // Zakres ubezpieczenia (array)
  // Dane z systemu zewnętrznego
  externalId            String?
  syncedAt              DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime           @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client        Client?            @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  vehicle       Vehicle?            @relation(fields: [vehicleId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  agent         User?               @relation("CalculationAssignee", fields: [agentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  organization  Organization?       @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  history       CalculationHistory[]
  externalSyncs ExternalSync[]

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([vehicleId])
  @@index([agentId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([clientId, status])
  @@map("calculations")
}

// InsuranceCompany Model (Towarzystwo Ubezpieczeniowe)
model InsuranceCompany {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String   @unique
  code        String?  @unique // Kod TU
  logoUrl     String?  // URL do logo
  website     String?  // Strona www
  integrationConfig Json? // Konfiguracja integracji (JSON)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  policies Policy[]

  @@index([code])
  @@map("insurance_companies")
}

// Policy Model (Polisa)
model Policy {
  id                String       @id @default(cuid())
  policyNumber      String       @unique // Numer polisy
  issueDate         DateTime     // Data wystawienia
  validFrom         DateTime     // Data ważności od
  validTo           DateTime     // Data ważności do
  status            PolicyStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  // Powiązania
  calculationId     String?      // Powiązana kalkulacja
  clientId          String?
  vehicleId         String?
  insuranceCompanyId String
  agentId           String?      // Agent który wystawił polisę
  organizationId    String?
  // Dane z systemu zewnętrznego
  externalId        String?
  syncedAt         DateTime?
  createdAt         DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations
  calculation       Calculation? @relation(fields: [calculationId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  client            Client?      @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  vehicle           Vehicle?     @relation(fields: [vehicleId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  insuranceCompany  InsuranceCompany @relation(fields: [insuranceCompanyId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  agent             User?        @relation("PolicyAssignee", fields: [agentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  organization      Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  documents         PolicyDocument[]
  history           PolicyHistory[]
  externalSyncs     ExternalSync[]

  @@index([policyNumber])
  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([vehicleId])
  @@index([insuranceCompanyId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([validTo])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([status, validTo])
  @@map("policies")
}

// PolicyDocument Model
model PolicyDocument {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  policyId  String
  filename  String
  path      String   // File path or URL
  size      Int?      // File size in bytes
  mimeType  String?
  uploadedBy String?  // User ID
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  policy Policy @relation(fields: [policyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([policyId])
  @@map("policy_documents")
}

// ExternalSync Model (Synchronizacja z systemem zewnętrznym)
model ExternalSync {
  id            String       @id @default(cuid())
  entityType    String       // "client", "vehicle", "calculation", "policy"
  entityId      String       // ID encji w CRM
  externalId    String?      // ID w systemie zewnętrznym
  direction     SyncDirection // IN lub OUT
  status        SyncStatus   @default(PENDING)
  syncedAt      DateTime?
  error         String?      // Błąd synchronizacji
  requestPayload Json?       // Payload requestu
  responsePayload Json?      // Payload odpowiedzi
  retryCount    Int          @default(0)
  nextRetryAt   DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Note: Relations are handled via entityType + entityId, not direct foreign keys
  // This allows syncing different entity types flexibly

  @@index([entityType])
  @@index([entityId])
  @@index([externalId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([syncedAt])
  @@unique([entityType, entityId, direction])
  @@map("external_syncs")
}

// OrganizationInsuranceSettings Model
model OrganizationInsuranceSettings {
  id                  String          @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId      String          @unique
  validationLevel     ValidationLevel @default(RELAXED)
  encryptionEnabled   Boolean         @default(false)
  auditRetentionDays  Int?            // Okres retencji logów audytu (dni)
  gdprEnabled         Boolean         @default(false)
  dataRetentionDays   Int?            // Okres retencji danych (dni)
  cacheEnabled        Boolean         @default(false)
  cacheTTL            Int?            // TTL cache w sekundach
  createdAt           DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime        @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("organization_insurance_settings")
}

// CalculationHistory Model
model CalculationHistory {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  calculationId String
  field         String   // Nazwa pola które się zmieniło
  oldValue      String?  // Stara wartość (JSON string)
  newValue      String?  // Nowa wartość (JSON string)
  changedBy     String?  // User ID
  changedAt     DateTime @default(now())
  reason        String?  // Powód zmiany

  // Relations
  calculation Calculation @relation(fields: [calculationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([calculationId])
  @@index([changedAt])
  @@map("calculation_history")
}

// PolicyHistory Model
model PolicyHistory {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  policyId      String
  field         String   // Nazwa pola które się zmieniło
  oldValue      String?  // Stara wartość (JSON string)
  newValue      String?  // Nowa wartość (JSON string)
  changedBy     String?  // User ID
  changedAt     DateTime @default(now())
  reason        String?  // Powód zmiany

  // Relations
  policy Policy @relation(fields: [policyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([policyId])
  @@index([changedAt])
  @@map("policy_history")
}

// AuditLog Model (rozszerzenie ActivityLog dla danych osobowych)
model AuditLog {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String
  action        String   // Typ akcji
  dataType      DataType // Typ danych (PERSONAL_DATA, VEHICLE_DATA, POLICY_DATA)
  entityType    String   // Typ encji
  entityId      String?  // ID encji
  dataBefore    Json?    // Dane przed zmianą
  dataAfter     Json?    // Dane po zmianie
  ipAddress     String?
  userAgent     String?
  retentionPeriod Int?   // Okres retencji (dni)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([dataType])
  @@index([entityType])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}

// DataConsent Model (Zgody RODO)
model DataConsent {
  id          String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId    String
  consentType ConsentType
  granted     Boolean      @default(false)
  grantedAt   DateTime?
  expiresAt   DateTime?    // Data wygaśnięcia zgody
  revokedAt   DateTime?    // Data cofnięcia zgody
  notes       String?      // Notatki
  createdAt   DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([consentType])
  @@index([granted])
  @@unique([clientId, consentType])
  @@map("data_consents")
}

```

```plaintext
// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum UserRole {
  ADMIN
  USER
}

enum ClientStatus {
  NEW_LEAD
  IN_CONTACT
  DEMO_SENT
  NEGOTIATION
  ACTIVE_CLIENT
  LOST
}

enum TaskStatus {
  TODO
  IN_PROGRESS
  COMPLETED
}

enum ContactType {
  PHONE_CALL
  MEETING
  EMAIL
  LINKEDIN_MESSAGE
  OTHER
}

enum ClientPriority {
  LOW
  MEDIUM
  HIGH
}

enum ClientType {
  PERSON
  COMPANY
}

enum PlanType {
  BASIC
  PRO
}

enum InsuranceVariant {
  MINIMAL
  OPTIMAL
  MAXIMAL
}

enum InsuranceScope {
  OC
  AC
  NNW
  ASS
}

enum CalculationStatus {
  DRAFT
  SENT
  ACCEPTED
  REJECTED
}

enum PolicyStatus {
  ACTIVE
  EXPIRED
  CANCELLED
  RENEWED
}

enum SyncDirection {
  IN
  OUT
}

enum SyncStatus {
  PENDING
  SUCCESS
  FAILED
}

enum ValidationLevel {
  STRICT
  RELAXED
}

enum ConsentType {
  MARKETING
  DATA_PROCESSING
  COMMUNICATION
}

enum DataType {
  PERSONAL_DATA
  VEHICLE_DATA
  POLICY_DATA
}

model User {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  email          String    @unique
  emailVerified  DateTime?
  name           String?
  image          String?
  password       String? // Nullable for OAuth users
  role           UserRole  @default(USER)
  position       String?
  organizationId String?
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization      Organization?      @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id])
  assignedClients   Client[]           @relation("ClientAssignee")
  assignedTasks      Task[]             @relation("TaskAssignee")
  contacts           Contact[]
  groups             UserGroup[]
  activities         ActivityLog[]
  preferences        UserPreferences?
  insuranceAgent     InsuranceAgent?
  assignedCalculations Calculation[]    @relation("CalculationAssignee")
  assignedPolicies   Policy[]           @relation("PolicyAssignee")

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("users")
}

model Group {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String   @unique
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  users          UserGroup[]
  sharedClients  Client[]    @relation("GroupSharedClients")
  sharedTasks    Task[]      @relation("GroupSharedTasks")
  sharedContacts Contact[]   @relation("GroupSharedContacts")

  @@map("groups")
}

model UserGroup {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  groupId   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user  User  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  group Group @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, groupId])
  @@map("user_groups")
}

model Client {
  id             String          @id @default(cuid())
  type           ClientType      @default(PERSON)
  // Fields for PERSON type
  firstName      String?
  lastName       String?
  pesel          String? // PESEL dla osoby fizycznej
  // Fields for COMPANY type
  companyName    String?
  taxId          String? // NIP / Tax ID
  regon          String? // REGON dla firmy
  // Common fields
  email          String?
  phone          String?
  website        String?
  address        String?
  source         String? // Lead source
  status         ClientStatus    @default(NEW_LEAD)
  priority       ClientPriority? // Priority for prospecting
  assignedTo     String? // User ID
  organizationId String?
  lastContactAt  DateTime? // Last contact date (auto-updated)
  nextFollowUpAt DateTime? // Next follow-up date
  // Additional fields for insurance agents
  previousLastName String? // Poprzednie nazwisko
  drivingLicenseDate DateTime? // Data uzyskania prawa jazdy
  occupation      String? // Zawód
  maritalStatus   String? // Stan cywilny
  hasChildUnder26 Boolean? @default(false) // Dziecko poniżej 26 roku życia
  // Correspondence address (if different)
  correspondenceAddress Json? // Adres korespondencyjny jako JSON
  createdAt      DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime        @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization    Organization?         @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id])
  assignee        User?                 @relation("ClientAssignee", fields: [assignedTo], references: [id])
  contacts        Contact[]
  tasks           Task[]
  statusHistory   ClientStatusHistory[]
  sharedGroups    Group[]               @relation("GroupSharedClients")
  integrationTabs IntegrationTab[]
  vehicleOwners   VehicleOwner[]
  calculations    Calculation[]
  policies        Policy[]
  dataConsents    DataConsent[]

  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([lastContactAt])
  @@index([nextFollowUpAt])
  @@index([assignedTo, status])
  @@map("clients")
}

model ClientStatusHistory {
  id        String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  status    ClientStatus
  changedAt DateTime     @default(now())
  changedBy String? // User ID
  notes     String?

  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("client_status_history")
}

model Contact {
  id        String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  type      ContactType? // Optional for notes (isNote=true)
  date      DateTime     @default(now())
  notes     String
  isNote    Boolean      @default(false) // Flag to distinguish notes from contacts
  userId    String // User who created the contact
  createdAt DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client       Client       @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user         User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  attachments  Attachment[]
  sharedGroups Group[]      @relation("GroupSharedContacts")

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([date])
  @@map("contacts")
}

model Attachment {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  contactId String
  filename  String
  path      String // File path or URL
  size      Int? // File size in bytes
  mimeType  String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  contact Contact @relation(fields: [contactId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("attachments")
}

model Task {
  id          String     @id @default(cuid())
  title       String
  description String?
  dueDate     DateTime?
  status      TaskStatus @default(TODO)
  assignedTo  String? // User ID
  clientId    String? // Optional client relation
  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime   @updatedAt

  // Relations
  assignee     User?   @relation("TaskAssignee", fields: [assignedTo], references: [id])
  client       Client? @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id])
  sharedGroups Group[] @relation("GroupSharedTasks")

  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([dueDate])
  @@index([assignedTo, status])
  @@map("tasks")
}

model ActivityLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  action     String // e.g., "CREATE_CLIENT", "UPDATE_CLIENT", "DELETE_CONTACT"
  entityType String // e.g., "Client", "Contact", "Task"
  entityId   String?
  details    Json? // Additional details as JSON
  ipAddress  String?
  userAgent  String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@map("activity_logs")
}

model UserPreferences {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String @unique
  user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // Theme and appearance
  theme    String? @default("light") // "light" | "dark"
  language String? @default("pl") // "pl" | "en"
  timezone String? // IANA timezone (e.g., "Europe/Warsaw", "America/New_York")

  // Color scheme
  primaryColor String? // Hex color (e.g., #3b82f6)
  themeName    String? // "blue" | "green" | "purple" | "red" | "custom" | "system"

  // Notifications
  emailTasks    Boolean @default(true)
  emailContacts Boolean @default(true)

  // Changelog tracking
  lastSeenVersion String? // Last version seen in "What's New"

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("user_preferences")
}

model SystemSettings {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  key       String   @unique
  value     String // JSON string or plain string
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("system_settings")
}

model Organization {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  plan      PlanType @default(BASIC)
  settings  Json? // Konfiguracja funkcji per-organizacja
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  users                    User[]
  clients                  Client[]
  featureFlags             FeatureFlag[]
  customFields             CustomField[]
  insuranceSettings        OrganizationInsuranceSettings?
  insuranceAgents          InsuranceAgent[]
  vehicles                 Vehicle[]
  calculations             Calculation[]
  policies                 Policy[]

  @@map("organizations")
}

model FeatureFlag {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId String?
  featureKey     String // np. "multi_tenant", "advanced_reports", "external_integrations"
  enabled        Boolean  @default(false)
  config         Json? // Dodatkowa konfiguracja
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([organizationId, featureKey])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([featureKey])
  @@map("feature_flags")
}

model IntegrationTab {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  title     String
  content   Json // Dynamiczna zawartość zakładki
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([order])
  @@map("integration_tabs")
}

model CustomField {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId String?
  name           String
  type           String // TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, SELECT
  required       Boolean  @default(false)
  options        Json? // Opcje dla typu SELECT
  order          Int      @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("custom_fields")
}

// Insurance Agent Model
model InsuranceAgent {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String   @unique
  licenseNumber String?  // Numer licencji agenta
  settings      Json?    // Konfiguracja widoczności elementów (JSON)
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  organizationId String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  user         User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  organization Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([isActive])
  @@map("insurance_agents")
}

// Vehicle Model
model Vehicle {
  id                    String   @id @default(cuid())
  vin                   String?  @unique // Vehicle Identification Number
  registrationNumber    String?  // Numer rejestracyjny
  firstRegistrationDate DateTime? // Data pierwszej rejestracji
  // Dane z Eurotax/Info-Ekspert (JSON)
  eurotaxData          Json?     // Dane z Eurotax
  infoEkspertData      Json?     // Dane z Info-Ekspert
  // Dodatkowe informacje
  importedFromAbroad   Boolean   @default(false) // Sprowadzony z zagranicy
  hasValidInspection  Boolean?  // Czy jest ważne badanie techniczne
  hasLpgInstallation  Boolean?  @default(false) // Czy posiada instalację gazową
  purchaseYear         Int?      // Rok nabycia pojazdu
  currentMileage       Int?      // Aktualny przebieg
  organizationId       String?
  createdAt            DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization  Organization?    @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  owners        VehicleOwner[]    // Relacja N:M z Client
  calculations  Calculation[]
  policies      Policy[]

  @@index([vin])
  @@index([registrationNumber])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("vehicles")
}

// VehicleOwner - relacja N:M między Vehicle a Client
model VehicleOwner {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  vehicleId String
  clientId  String
  isPrimary Boolean  @default(true) // Główny właściciel
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  vehicle Vehicle @relation(fields: [vehicleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  client  Client  @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([vehicleId, clientId])
  @@index([vehicleId])
  @@index([clientId])
  @@map("vehicle_owners")
}

// Calculation Model (Kalkulacja/Szansa sprzedaży)
model Calculation {
  id                    String            @id @default(cuid())
  // Dane osobowe klienta
  pesel                 String?
  firstName             String?
  lastName              String?
  previousLastName      String?           // Poprzednie nazwisko
  phone                 String?
  email                 String?
  // Adres zamieszkania
  postalCode            String?           // Kod pocztowy
  city                  String?           // Miejscowość/Poczta
  street                String?           // Ulica
  houseNumber           String?           // Numer domu
  apartmentNumber       String?           // Numer mieszkania
  // Adres korespondencyjny (jeśli inny)
  correspondenceAddress Json?             // Adres korespondencyjny jako JSON
  // Dane dodatkowe
  hasDrivingLicense     Boolean?           // Prawo jazdy odpowiednie dla pojazdu
  drivingLicenseDate    DateTime?         // Data uzyskania prawa jazdy
  occupation            String?            // Zawód
  maritalStatus         String?            // Stan cywilny
  hasChildUnder26       Boolean?           @default(false) // Dziecko poniżej 26 roku życia
  // Powiązania
  clientId              String?
  vehicleId             String?
  agentId               String?            // Przypisany agent
  organizationId        String?
  // Pola biznesowe
  status                CalculationStatus  @default(DRAFT)
  value                 Decimal?           @db.Decimal(10, 2) // Wartość kalkulacji
  validUntil            DateTime?          // Data ważności
  // Dane z formularza ubezpieczenia
  variant               InsuranceVariant?    // Wariant ubezpieczenia
  scopes                InsuranceScope[]   // Zakres ubezpieczenia (array)
  // Dane z systemu zewnętrznego
  externalId            String?
  syncedAt              DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime           @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client        Client?            @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  vehicle       Vehicle?            @relation(fields: [vehicleId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  agent         User?               @relation("CalculationAssignee", fields: [agentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  organization  Organization?       @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  history       CalculationHistory[]

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([vehicleId])
  @@index([agentId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([clientId, status])
  @@map("calculations")
}

// InsuranceCompany Model (Towarzystwo Ubezpieczeniowe)
model InsuranceCompany {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String   @unique
  code        String?  @unique // Kod TU
  logoUrl     String?  // URL do logo
  website     String?  // Strona www
  integrationConfig Json? // Konfiguracja integracji (JSON)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  policies Policy[]

  @@index([code])
  @@map("insurance_companies")
}

// Policy Model (Polisa)
model Policy {
  id                String       @id @default(cuid())
  policyNumber      String       @unique // Numer polisy
  issueDate         DateTime     // Data wystawienia
  validFrom         DateTime     // Data ważności od
  validTo           DateTime     // Data ważności do
  status            PolicyStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  // Powiązania
  calculationId     String?      // Powiązana kalkulacja
  clientId          String?
  vehicleId         String?
  insuranceCompanyId String
  agentId           String?      // Agent który wystawił polisę
  organizationId    String?
  // Dane z systemu zewnętrznego
  externalId        String?
  syncedAt         DateTime?
  createdAt         DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations
  calculation       Calculation? @relation(fields: [calculationId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  client            Client?      @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  vehicle           Vehicle?     @relation(fields: [vehicleId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  insuranceCompany  InsuranceCompany @relation(fields: [insuranceCompanyId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  agent             User?        @relation("PolicyAssignee", fields: [agentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  organization      Organization? @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  documents         PolicyDocument[]
  history           PolicyHistory[]
  externalSyncs     ExternalSync[]

  @@index([policyNumber])
  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([vehicleId])
  @@index([insuranceCompanyId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([validTo])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([status, validTo])
  @@map("policies")
}

// PolicyDocument Model
model PolicyDocument {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  policyId  String
  filename  String
  path      String   // File path or URL
  size      Int?      // File size in bytes
  mimeType  String?
  uploadedBy String?  // User ID
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  policy Policy @relation(fields: [policyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([policyId])
  @@map("policy_documents")
}

// ExternalSync Model (Synchronizacja z systemem zewnętrznym)
model ExternalSync {
  id            String       @id @default(cuid())
  entityType    String       // "client", "vehicle", "calculation", "policy"
  entityId      String       // ID encji w CRM
  externalId    String?      // ID w systemie zewnętrznym
  direction     SyncDirection // IN lub OUT
  status        SyncStatus   @default(PENDING)
  syncedAt      DateTime?
  error         String?      // Błąd synchronizacji
  requestPayload Json?       // Payload requestu
  responsePayload Json?      // Payload odpowiedzi
  retryCount    Int          @default(0)
  nextRetryAt   DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Note: Relations are handled via entityType + entityId, not direct foreign keys
  // This allows syncing different entity types flexibly

  @@index([entityType])
  @@index([entityId])
  @@index([externalId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([syncedAt])
  @@unique([entityType, entityId, direction])
  @@map("external_syncs")
}

// OrganizationInsuranceSettings Model
model OrganizationInsuranceSettings {
  id                  String          @id @default(cuid())
  organizationId      String          @unique
  validationLevel     ValidationLevel @default(RELAXED)
  encryptionEnabled   Boolean         @default(false)
  auditRetentionDays  Int?            // Okres retencji logów audytu (dni)
  gdprEnabled         Boolean         @default(false)
  dataRetentionDays   Int?            // Okres retencji danych (dni)
  cacheEnabled        Boolean         @default(false)
  cacheTTL            Int?            // TTL cache w sekundach
  createdAt           DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime        @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("organization_insurance_settings")
}

// CalculationHistory Model
model CalculationHistory {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  calculationId String
  field         String   // Nazwa pola które się zmieniło
  oldValue      String?  // Stara wartość (JSON string)
  newValue      String?  // Nowa wartość (JSON string)
  changedBy     String?  // User ID
  changedAt     DateTime @default(now())
  reason        String?  // Powód zmiany

  // Relations
  calculation Calculation @relation(fields: [calculationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([calculationId])
  @@index([changedAt])
  @@map("calculation_history")
}

// PolicyHistory Model
model PolicyHistory {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  policyId      String
  field         String   // Nazwa pola które się zmieniło
  oldValue      String?  // Stara wartość (JSON string)
  newValue      String?  // Nowa wartość (JSON string)
  changedBy     String?  // User ID
  changedAt     DateTime @default(now())
  reason        String?  // Powód zmiany

  // Relations
  policy Policy @relation(fields: [policyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([policyId])
  @@index([changedAt])
  @@map("policy_history")
}

// AuditLog Model (rozszerzenie ActivityLog dla danych osobowych)
model AuditLog {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String
  action        String   // Typ akcji
  dataType      DataType // Typ danych (PERSONAL_DATA, VEHICLE_DATA, POLICY_DATA)
  entityType    String   // Typ encji
  entityId      String?  // ID encji
  dataBefore    Json?    // Dane przed zmianą
  dataAfter     Json?    // Dane po zmianie
  ipAddress     String?
  userAgent     String?
  retentionPeriod Int?   // Okres retencji (dni)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([dataType])
  @@index([entityType])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}

// DataConsent Model (Zgody RODO)
model DataConsent {
  id          String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId    String
  consentType ConsentType
  granted     Boolean      @default(false)
  grantedAt   DateTime?
  expiresAt   DateTime?    // Data wygaśnięcia zgody
  revokedAt   DateTime?    // Data cofnięcia zgody
  notes       String?      // Notatki
  createdAt   DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([consentType])
  @@index([granted])
  @@unique([clientId, consentType])
  @@map("data_consents")
}

```

```plaintext
// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum UserRole {
  ADMIN
  USER
}

enum ClientStatus {
  NEW_LEAD
  IN_CONTACT
  DEMO_SENT
  NEGOTIATION
  ACTIVE_CLIENT
  LOST
}

enum TaskStatus {
  TODO
  IN_PROGRESS
  COMPLETED
}

enum ContactType {
  PHONE_CALL
  MEETING
  EMAIL
  LINKEDIN_MESSAGE
  OTHER
}

enum ClientPriority {
  LOW
  MEDIUM
  HIGH
}

enum ClientType {
  PERSON
  COMPANY
}

enum PlanType {
  BASIC
  PRO
}

enum InsuranceVariant {
  MINIMAL
  OPTIMAL
  MAXIMAL
}

enum InsuranceScope {
  OC
  AC
  NNW
  ASS
}

enum CalculationStatus {
  DRAFT
  SENT
  ACCEPTED
  REJECTED
}

enum PolicyStatus {
  ACTIVE
  EXPIRED
  CANCELLED
  RENEWED
}

enum SyncDirection {
  IN
  OUT
}

enum SyncStatus {
  PENDING
  SUCCESS
  FAILED
}

enum ValidationLevel {
  STRICT
  RELAXED
}

enum ConsentType {
  MARKETING
  DATA_PROCESSING
  COMMUNICATION
}

enum DataType {
  PERSONAL_DATA
  VEHICLE_DATA
  POLICY_DATA
}

model User {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  email          String    @unique
  emailVerified  DateTime?
  name           String?
  image          String?
  password       String? // Nullable for OAuth users
  role           UserRole  @default(USER)
  position       String?
  organizationId String?
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization      Organization?      @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id])
  assignedClients   Client[]           @relation("ClientAssignee")
  assignedTasks      Task[]             @relation("TaskAssignee")
  contacts           Contact[]
  groups             UserGroup[]
  activities         ActivityLog[]
  preferences        UserPreferences?
  insuranceAgent     InsuranceAgent?
  assignedCalculations Calculation[]    @relation("CalculationAssignee")
  assignedPolicies   Policy[]           @relation("PolicyAssignee")

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("users")
}

model Group {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String   @unique
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  users          UserGroup[]
  sharedClients  Client[]    @relation("GroupSharedClients")
  sharedTasks    Task[]      @relation("GroupSharedTasks")
  sharedContacts Contact[]   @relation("GroupSharedContacts")

  @@map("groups")
}

model UserGroup {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  groupId   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user  User  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  group Group @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, groupId])
  @@map("user_groups")
}

model Client {
  id             String          @id @default(cuid())
  type           ClientType      @default(PERSON)
  // Fields for PERSON type
  firstName      String?
  lastName       String?
  pesel          String? // PESEL dla osoby fizycznej
  // Fields for COMPANY type
  companyName    String?
  taxId          String? // NIP / Tax ID
  regon          String? // REGON dla firmy
  // Common fields
  email          String?
  phone          String?
  website        String?
  address        String?
  source         String? // Lead source
  status         ClientStatus    @default(NEW_LEAD)
  priority       ClientPriority? // Priority for prospecting
  assignedTo     String? // User ID
  organizationId String?
  lastContactAt  DateTime? // Last contact date (auto-updated)
  nextFollowUpAt DateTime? // Next follow-up date
  // Additional fields for insurance agents
  previousLastName String? // Poprzednie nazwisko
  drivingLicenseDate DateTime? // Data uzyskania prawa jazdy
  occupation      String? // Zawód
  maritalStatus   String? // Stan cywilny
  hasChildUnder26 Boolean? @default(false) // Dziecko poniżej 26 roku życia
  // Correspondence address (if different)
  correspondenceAddress Json? // Adres korespondencyjny jako JSON
  createdAt      DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime        @updatedAt

  // Relations
  organization    Organization?         @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id])
  assignee        User?                 @relation("ClientAssignee", fields: [assignedTo], references: [id])
  contacts        Contact[]
  tasks           Task[]
  statusHistory   ClientStatusHistory[]
  sharedGroups    Group[]               @relation("GroupSharedClients")
  integrationTabs IntegrationTab[]
  vehicleOwners   VehicleOwner[]
  calculations    Calculation[]
  policies        Policy[]
  dataConsents    DataConsent[]

  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([lastContactAt])
  @@index([nextFollowUpAt])
  @@index([assignedTo, status])
  @@map("clients")
}

model ClientStatusHistory {
  id        String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  status    ClientStatus
  changedAt DateTime     @default(now())
  changedBy String? // User ID
  notes     String?

  client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("client_status_history")
}

model Contact {
  id        String       @id @default(cuid())
  clientId  String
  type      ContactType? // Optional for notes (isNote=true)
  date      DateTime     @default(now())
  notes     String
  isNote    Boolean      @default(false) // Flag to distinguish notes from contacts
  userId    String // User who created the contact
  createdAt DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime     @updatedAt

  // Relations
  client       Client       @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user         User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  attachments  Attachment[]
  sharedGroups Group[]      @relation("GroupSharedContacts")

  @@index([clientId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([date])
  @@map("contacts")
}

model Attachment {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  contactId String
  filename  String
  path      String // File path or URL
  size      Int? // File size in bytes
  mimeType  String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  contact Contact @relation(fields: [contactId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("attachments")
}

model Task {

  client       Client? @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id])

  @@index([assignedTo])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([dueDate])
  @@index([assignedTo, status])
  @@map("tasks")
}

model ActivityLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  action     String // e.g., "CREATE_CLIENT", "UPDATE_CLIENT", "DELETE_CONTACT"
  entityType String // e.g., "Client", "Contact", "Task"
  entityId   String?
  details    Json? // Additional details as JSON

model UserPreferences {

  user   User   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // Theme and appearance

  language String? @default("pl") // "pl" | "en"

  @@map("user_preferences")
```
